free_tier.stated: no free tier; the entry plan is JPY 1,265 a month for 2 GB

retention.stated: monthly; the server persists while paid

egress.terms: no traffic quota was read on the product page

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing chains, because no new account can be opened: the value of the record is that a Japanese reader who saw ' VPS' in 2025 arrives at a closed door in 2026.
limits_note: The free instance survives at most 24 hours and must be renewed by hand from the control panel each day
binding_note: the price binds: there is no shape at this vendor under USD 5 a month

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the product and price pages were read, the signup path was not. The vendor is Japanese-language only and the order form is on a separate domain (secure.xserver.ne.jp), so a card and probably a Japanese phone are involved; neither is documented here

evidence.proved: the plan table gives 無料VPS 2GB as 2 GB memory, 2 vCPU, 30 GB NVMe at 月額 0円 and 無料VPS 4GB as 4 GB memory, 3 vCPU, 30 GB NVMe at 月額 0円, with 初期費用 無料; the page carries the note 'ご利用にはクレジットカードの登録が必要になります' and the signup button reads '受付停止中'
the vendor's notice dated 2026/07/10 states, in Japanese, that new applications for both free plans are suspended because server stock is short, and that existing free users are unaffected
the vendor's notice states that from 2026-07-22 17:00 the free plan's usable period drops from 96 hours (2 GB) and 48 hours (4 GB) to 24 hours for both, and that renewal opens when 12 hours remain
the launch release dated 2025-07-10 gives the shape as 2 GB or 4 GB memory, 2 or 3 cores, 30 GB disk, 30 Mbps, manual renewal every four days (2 GB) or two days (4 GB), image saving unavailable
quoted: '月額**1,265**円～' and '2GB 月額1,265円～ 小規模サイトや個人開発に最適 メモリ 2GB vCPU 3コア NVMe SSD 50GB'

notes: The lead was worth closing: XServer is one of the largest Japanese hosts and its floor is above the line. No under-USD-5 shape exists, so nothing here can qualify whatever the identity terms are.

session_cap.note: none; it is a VPS that bills whether it runs or not

confidence_note: price and shape from the vendor's product page today; identity explicitly unverified
